messages:
leo_marketing: Heads-up — 16 webinar leads from last night showed up in HubSpot but were never assigned. HS prop `enrichment_state=queued` and SF owner blank.
amy_revops: yikes. any pattern? region / campaign?
devon_eng: quick triage: enrichment svc returned intermittent timeouts (504). our RR filter excludes `enrichment_state=queued` and there's no HS fallback step.
jace_sdr: missed pings from reps. those were warm attendees.
amy_revops: short-term: fallback to `sdr_oncall_pool` after 10s for queued leads. add analytics event `fallback_enrichment_timeout` and alert if >3% in 30m.
devon_eng: can do. patch snippet I'll canary:
```
if (lead.enrichment_state === 'queued' && now - lead.enrichment_started > 10000) {
  assignOwner('sdr_oncall_pool', lead, 'fallback_timeout')
}
```
leadflow_bot: Deploy started: routing-lambda v3.3.0-canary -> 2 nodes.
devon_eng: canary ok; tested 10 synthetic leads, 9 assigned fallback at ~10s.
amy_revops: also add HS workflow `set owner if empty` immediately on intake tagging `hs_auto=true` so reps get notifications.
leo_marketing: i'll update HS and add a note to the webinar doc. include link to this thread.
leadflow_bot: Alert: inbound_handoff_sla spike 4.2% between 01:10-01:40 UTC — mitigation applied.
amy_revops: plan: 1) prod rollout in waves 2) analytics dashboard + alerting 3) HS workflow update 4) 48h conversion cohort on fallback vs normal.
jace_sdr: i'll monitor and report rep feedback. :thumbsup:
devon_eng: rolling to prod now.
leadflow_bot: Prod rollout complete. current fallback_rate=2.4% (last 30m). Closing after 48h if conversion stable.
